en_title: Silent Hill Remake Studio Wants to Make Physical Games 'for as Long as Possible'
cn_title: 《寂静岭》团队盼长久发行实体版
subtitle: 收藏里的情感联系
opus_summary: 《寂静岭》开发商Bloober Team希望尽可能长久地推出实体版游戏。负责人承认数字发行更便捷、便宜且利润更高，但强调实体收藏能让玩家与游戏及工作室建立情感联系。

paragraphs.en: Silent Hill developer Bloober Team wants to make physical versions of its games "for as long as possible."
paragraphs.cn: 《寂静岭》开发商Bloober Team希望「尽可能长久地」为旗下游戏推出实体版。

paragraphs.en: Studio CEO Piotr Babieno opened up about the company's appreciation for physical media and collectibles during an interview with GamesRadar . He started his thoughts by touching on how the gaming landscape and player desires have changed as technology has advanced over the years, explaining that "we have reached a moment where you can't really do much more" in terms of visual and auditory fidelity.
paragraphs.cn: 工作室首席执行官Piotr Babieno在接受GamesRadar采访时，谈到了公司对实体媒介和收藏品的重视。他先谈起多年来技术进步如何改变游戏行业面貌与玩家需求，并表示，在视听保真度方面，「我们已经到了很难再有太多提升的阶段」。

paragraphs.en: "Like, OK, the game can have a slightly higher resolution and maybe better lighting and whatever, but will it make it a more engaging game? I don't think so," Babieno said.
paragraphs.cn: Babieno说：「比如，好吧，游戏的分辨率可以再高一点，光照之类的效果或许也能更好，但这样就能让游戏更吸引人吗？我不这么认为。」

paragraphs.en: The CEO for the studio behind the Silent Hill 2 remake and its in-development original Silent Hill remake also talked about how stats show "the majority of players are playing on hardware which is five, seven years old, if not older." He continued, saying, "But are they less interested in games because of that? I don't think so."
paragraphs.cn: 这家工作室开发了《寂静岭2》重制版，目前也在制作初代《寂静岭》的重制版。Babieno还提到，统计数据显示，「大多数玩家使用的硬件已经有五年、七年，甚至更久了」。他接着说：「但他们会因此对游戏失去兴趣吗？我不这么认为。」

paragraphs.en: As AI shapes a new, controversial future in the gaming industry, the Bloober executive seems to be more interested in "thinking about other senses." It's this mindset that the team has carried into its new Nintendo Switch 2-exclusive 2.5D horror game, Onyx: The Dark Group . For this experience, which comes from Bloober subsidiary Broken Mirror Games, it's become about "putting horror back in your hands."
paragraphs.cn: AI正在为游戏行业塑造一个充满争议的新未来，而这位Bloober高管似乎更有兴趣「思考其他感官」。团队也将这种思路带入了任天堂Switch 2独占的2.5D恐怖新作《Onyx: The Dark Group》。这款由Bloober旗下Broken Mirror Games开发的游戏，着眼于「将恐怖重新带回你的手中」。

paragraphs.en: "As humans, we have four other senses, and AI can deliver something for what you see, for what you hear, but why not touch?" Babieno said. "I think the physical element of gaming will always, always be there."
paragraphs.cn: Babieno说：「人类还有另外四种感官，AI可以在视觉、听觉上提供一些东西，但为什么不考虑触觉呢？我认为，游戏的实体元素永远、永远都会存在。」

paragraphs.en: When the conversation turned to the topic of physical games – which has become a hot-button issue in the wake of Sony's decision to kill disc releases for PlayStation games , as well as Rockstar's disc-less approach to Grand Theft Auto 6 – Babieno admitted he does see why some are beginning to favor digital releases. After all, as he said, "digital distribution is much easier, much cheaper, and will be more profitable for everyone."
paragraphs.cn: 随着索尼决定停止发行PlayStation游戏光盘，以及Rockstar对《GTA6》（《侠盗猎车手6》）采取不发行光盘的方式，实体游戏已成为热议话题。谈到这个话题时，Babieno承认，他确实理解为什么一些人开始倾向于数字发行。毕竟，正如他所说，「数字发行方便得多、便宜得多，也会让各方获得更高的利润」。

paragraphs.en: For Babieno, it's hard not to think about how game collecting has affected him, personally, when looking to the future .
paragraphs.cn: 对Babieno而言，展望未来时，很难不去想收藏游戏给他个人带来的影响。

paragraphs.en: "Collecting games also [made] an emotional connection between the game and me, between the studio which produced the game and me," he said. "This little emotional touch is so important that, I think in some way, we would lose the opportunity of being closer with our fans [without it]. So, if we are able to produce a [physical] retail version of our games, we would like to make them for as long as possible."
paragraphs.cn: 他说：「收藏游戏也让我与游戏、与制作游戏的工作室建立了情感联系。这一点小小的情感触动非常重要，我觉得，如果没有它，我们在某种程度上就会失去与粉丝拉近距离的机会。所以，只要我们还能为旗下游戏制作实体零售版，我们就希望尽可能长久地做下去。」

paragraphs.en: Also during the interview, Broken Mirror's executive director, Tymon Smektala, who left Dying Light developer Techland to join the Bloober company earlier this year, said that he and Babieno both share a love for game collecting.
paragraphs.cn: Broken Mirror执行总监Tymon Smektala也在采访中表示，他和Babieno都热爱收藏游戏。他在今年早些时候离开《消逝的光芒》开发商Techland，加入了这家Bloober旗下公司。

paragraphs.en: "Like, if I could unblur my screen, you would see lots of stuff behind me and I have lots of stuff that's not even in the camera, so this is what gaming is to us," he said during the video interview. "This is the gaming I know, and this is the gaming I expect. And as long as it will be possible, and as long as the big decision makers will allow us to have that, then of course I'll be into that."
paragraphs.cn: 他在视频采访中说：「比如，如果我能关掉背景模糊，你就会看到我身后有很多东西，还有很多根本没出现在镜头里。所以，对我们来说，游戏就是这样。这是我熟悉的游戏，也是我期待的游戏。只要条件允许，只要那些掌握重大决策权的人还允许我们拥有这些，我当然就会继续支持。」

paragraphs.en: Bloober's Silent Hill 2 remake was initially released for PC and PlayStation 5 in 2024 and received physical disc support at the time. Supporting that angle for future games will officially become more complicated when Sony ends support for PlayStation discs in 2028. The Silent Hill 1 remake was announced in June of last year and currently remains without a release date. It's unclear if it will be out before Sony ends support on its end.
paragraphs.cn: Bloober的《寂静岭2》重制版于2024年首发登陆PC和PS5，当时也发行了实体光盘版。等到索尼在2028年停止支持PlayStation光盘，为今后的游戏推出实体版就会变得更加复杂。初代《寂静岭》重制版于去年6月公布，目前仍未确定发售日期。该作能否赶在索尼停止支持光盘之前推出，目前尚不清楚。
